description: A discrete round mound about 15 m across and up to c. 1.5 m high, with a hollow in its eastern flank, isolated on flat drained former moorland now under a young deciduous plantation. The mound has been left in an unplanted clearing. No modern object stands on it in five orthophoto flights 2014-2025. The 1900 Messtischblatt shows wet meadow or moor here with no monument or extraction symbol.
alt_question: Could this be a spoil heap from ditch digging or peat working on the former moor (with the eastern hollow as a later dig or animal burrow), rather than a burial mound?

facts.statement: Local relief at the centre reaches 1.51 m (15 m window).
No registered Grabhügel within 300 m in the public Denkmalatlas Grabhügel snapshot.
OSM shows only forest land use near the point; no modern object within 30 m.
The mound lies in an unplanted clearing within the plantation.
The 1900 map shows wet meadow/moor signature at the point.

limitations: The small pale patch at the cross in 2020 could not be resolved (bare sand, burrowing or minor digging); no older DGM1 epoch to test whether the eastern hollow is recent; Messtischblatt georeferencing unmeasured; only one Messtischblatt edition.
